verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a hosting and data platform like Netlify, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of retention settings, data deletion, or account and data purge controls. Deploy rollback, cache invalidation, and Blobs/Database storage are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not retention and deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
